newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos estimates stand - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos estimates stand - analyst.

text.p: Jeffries & Co analyst Lee Isgur on Monday said he was standing by his earlier profit estimates on Grand Casinos Inc after the company said it supported a restructuring plan by Stratosphere Corp.
Isgur's earnings estimates on Grand Casinos before extraordinary items are $1.48 a share for 1996 and $1.87 for 1997. In 1995, the company earned $1.90 a share before extraordinary items.

Late Monday, Grand Casinos said it would take a 1996 fourth-quarter charge of $3.15 to $3.50 related to the write-off of an investment in Stratosphere, which is building a 2,500-room casino and hotel in Las Vegas.
"They could have walked and written their whole investment off," Isgur told Reuters.

Grand Casinos agreed to convert $50 million due from Stratosphere into 40 percent of the common shares of Stratosphere. Upon completion of a related rights offering, Grand Casinos will own 65 percent of Stratosphere.

"The (Stratosphere) business has improved a bit, and they (Grand Casinos) feel this additional money is going to create the critical mass they need to get respectable cash flows out of the project," he said.
Grand Casino stock closed down 5/8 to 13-1/2 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Stratosphere ended at 1-1/8, up 1/16, on the Nasdaq.
